# HexPiece 2.8.8

- **Light fruit animations now play:** every Light fruit move was animating under the idle stance (hands in pockets), so nothing showed.
  The moves now play over the stance and hand back to it when they end. The Dragon fruit's human-form moves play the same way.
- **Ama no Murakumo is held by its handle:** the guard now sits just past your fist and the grip runs through your hand, in third
  person and in first person (where it sits in your own first-person hand).
- **The light clones are rebuilt:** each clone is now your own body made of light: your skin and shape, glowing white and gold, its
  edges burning. It runs at the enemy with afterimages behind it, makes two real sword cuts with Ama no Murakumo, then bursts into
  light.
- Nothing here has been tested in game yet. The build's checks pass, and the clones and the grip were rendered and checked off-game.
